title: 2019-20 Panini Mosaic Got Game? Mosaic Green #4 Kemba Walker Celtics NBA
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019-20 Panini Mosaic Got Game? Mosaic Green #4 Kemba Walker card is the perfect addition to any National Basketball Association (NBA) fan's collection. Featuring Kemba Walker of the Boston Celtics, this sports trading card is an original, near mint/mint condition piece that any collector would be proud to own.

As a single card from the Panini Mosaic brand, it is a modern (1970-now) product with an original design and card number #4. This trading card is part of the 2019-20 set and is a must-have for fans of Kemba Walker and the Boston Celtics.
